source_title: NOV. 4: PURE ROMANCE TO HOST INTIMACY INDUSTRY'S FIRST 24-HOUR LIVE SHOPPING EXPERIENCE
source_excerpt:
National Sex Toy Day event will feature 24 consecutive hours of live programming, $24,000 in giveaways, exclusive product launches and savings up to 85% off
CINCINNATI , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Pure Romance , a leading global intimacy and sexual wellness company, is making industry history this National Sex Toy Day with the intimacy industry's first 24-hour live shopping experience on Wednesday, Nov. 4.
For 24 consecutive hours, Pure Romance will broadcast live with entertainment, sexual wellness education, expert conversations, product demonstrations, exclusive launches and real-time shopping.
Throughout the event, Pure Romance will give away $24,000 in prizes , while customers will have access to savings of up to 85% off , exclusive live offers and new product launches.
"For more than 30 years, Pure Romance has pushed this industry forward, from the way we talk about sexual wellness to the way customers discover and shop for products," said Patty Brisben, Founder of Pure Romance . "Now, we're doing it again. A 24-hour live shopping experience has never been done in our industry at this scale. We're combining education, entertainment, experts, product launches, incredible savings and $24,000 in giveaways into one nonstop experience. National Sex Toy Day is the perfect day to make a little history."
The marathon event will feature Pure Romance hosts, special guests and experts for candid conversations about intimacy, relationships, pleasure and sexual wellness. Viewers can ask questions, interact in real time, discover products through live demonstrations and shop throughout the broadcast.
Programming will cover some of the most talked-about topics in sexual wellness, including relationships, orgasms, couples' play, role play and sexual health.
The event marks a major milestone in the evolution of Pure Romance's live shopping platform, combining entertainment, education, community and commerce to make conversations around intimacy more accessible and engaging.
The 24-hour National Sex Toy Day live shopping experience begins Nov. 4. Viewers can tune in throughout the day for savings up to 85% off, exclusive product launches and the chance to win a share of $24,000 in giveaways.
For more than 30 years, Pure Romance has been a leader in intimacy and sexual wellness, helping people have better conversations about relationships, confidence and pleasure. With more than $3 billion in lifetime sales, Pure Romance serves customers in the United States and internationally.
